title: Setup and invites carry the https address Tailscale serves the install at
description: The real host loop sync and control plane, with only a stub tailscale on PATH whose status reports this machine's node and whose serve status maps :8447 over HTTPS to the server's loopback port, and a machine directory written before GY-3294 (no node recorded). Team access carries installUrl https://vishrog.tail3739e3.ts.net:8447 and no 'Tailscale is not serving' guidance; with a saved share link an invite's message, sign-in link and install URL all use that address; with a mapping for another port only, the warning names this install's port. Setup shows 'This install: https://vishrog.tail3739e3.ts.net:8447' with no warning. No Docker or Tailscale credentials.

steps.name: The loop sync reads the served https address; team access and invites carry it
